answer: Like an onyx seal stamped only once, give each agent identity one verified utility account: a real electricity meter whose billing record is attested by the utility and bound to the identity key. A second identity on the same meter is rejected, and meters are re-checked each epoch. An attacker who wants a thousand fakes must open a thousand separate real utility accounts, paying connection fees and monthly bills for each, while a comet trail of billing history makes a forged meter easy to spot and an ember of unpaid debt revokes the identity.
